title: Carrot Dal with Tempeh Breadcrumbs
description: Comforting lentil dal loaded with carrots and topped with super-crispy tempeh breadcrumbs.
style: Protein-rich, wholesome plant-based dal with crunchy tempeh topping

title: Creamy Butter Chickpea with Golden Paneer or Seitan Curry
description: A rich, slow-simmered chickpea curry finished with cream or coconut milk and topped with crispy golden paneer or seitan. Even better the next day.
style: Comforting, creamy chickpea curry with spiced tomato gravy and golden paneer or seitan.

title: Creamy Butter Chickpeas & Garlic Naan
description: Le Cocque-inspired butter chickpeas with a quick, garlicky stovetop naan.
style: Comforting, creamy chickpeas with quick stovetop naan (vegan option).

title: Creamy Coconut Lime Tofu
description: A fast yet deeply flavoured coconut lime tofu that tastes like it’s been simmering for hours. Perfect over steamed rice.
style: Rich, creamy coconut-lime tofu with Thai-inspired red curry heat.

title: Crispy Chilli Garlic Tofu
description: Golden fried tofu coated in a glossy chilli-garlic sauce with tamari, agave, and crispy chilli oil.
style: Ultra-crispy tofu tossed in a sticky, spicy chilli-garlic sauce.

title: High-Protein Vegan Salad
description: A satisfying vegan protein salad with marinated tempeh, baked tofu, chickpeas, and greens—delivering ~30 g plant-based protein per serving.
style: Hearty, nourishing salad packed with plant-based protein and fibre.

title: Kerala Style Roasted Okra (Vendakka Mezhukkupuratti)
description: A simple Kerala-style okra stir-fry that’s crispy, aromatic, and perfectly spiced—no slime, just flavour.
style: Crispy, spice-roasted okra with classic Kerala flavours and zero slime.

title: Protein-Packed Buddha Bowl
description: An easy, protein-packed buddha bowl with brown rice, chickpeas, roasted sweet potato, and a punchy peanut-maple dressing.
style: Simple, nourishing buddha bowl with roasted sweet potato and a creamy peanut dressing.

title: Sticky Tofu & Mushroom Bowl
description: Golden roasted tofu and mushrooms tossed in a savoury soy–chilli glaze, served over rice with quick-pickled cucumber and fresh herbs.
style: Crispy roasted tofu and shiitake mushrooms with bold five-spice flavour and a punchy soy-chili glaze.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Beans & Roasted Aubergine
description: Creamy sun-dried tomato borlotti beans paired with tamari-maple roasted aubergine—ready in 30 minutes and perfect for meal prep.
style: Saucy, creamy, and comforting high-protein beans with sweet-savoury roasted aubergine.

title: Tahini Chilli Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Golden baked tofu tossed with udon noodles, greens, and a rich tahini chilli sauce that’s savoury, spicy, and deeply satisfying.
style: Crispy baked tofu with chewy noodles and a creamy, spicy tahini chilli sauce.
